headline: Flagler complete an unbeaten conference season
dek: Flagler beat Georgia Southwestern on Monday to close their conference schedule without a defeat, North Georgia the only side to take a point from them. Their one loss all season came outside the conference, at Florida Southern in September.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Flagler's 39 goals are more than USC Aiken and Georgia Southwestern have scored between them, and twelve different players have shared them.

wire.line: Flagler went through the conference unbeaten, and North Georgia were the only side to take a point off them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, every one of them from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Middle Georgia State have conceded 48 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, while scoring 29.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored eleven of Middle Georgia State's 29 goals from 52 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finn Weigelt has scored eleven of Flagler's 39 goals from 37 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored nine of North Georgia's 39 goals from 44 shots.

last_match.line: Georgia Southwestern go through the conference schedule without a win, and have lost both matches since the draw at Clayton State.

next_match.line: USC Aiken have beaten Lander home and away this season, and Lander have not won since they beat North Georgia.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
